title: phlomis orientalis subsp. caucasica
intro: Phlomis orientalis subsp. caucasica, commonly known as Caucasian Lamiaceae or Oriental Jerusalem Sage, is a subspecies of flowering plant within the Phlomis orientalis species. This perennial plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Phlomis orientalis subsp. caucasica include sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for anxiety, pain relief, and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
